prompt: gperf --pic struct-type first field type requirement
answer:
With `--pic` (`-P` or `%pic`) and `--struct-type` (`-t` or `%struct-type`), the first field of the user-defined `struct` must be of type `int`, not `char *` or `const char *`. It stores offsets into the string pool rather than actual strings.

The field is normally named `name`, unless changed with `-K` or `%define slot-name`.
